T9.1.ref: CREATE TABLE person (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(250), role VARCHAR(100));

T9.2.ref: CREATE TABLE property (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(250), area VARCHAR(250), district VARCHAR(100));

T9.3.ref: CREATE TABLE booking (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, property_id INTEGER, booked_by INTEGER, check_in DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY (property_id) REFERENCES property(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (booked_by) REFERENCES person(id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

T9.4.ref: CREATE TABLE booking_guest (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, booking_id INTEGER, person_id INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (booking_id) REFERENCES booking(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES person(id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
